data.one_liner: Dart implementation of JsonLogic to evaluate JSON logic rules.
data.what_it_does: Evaluates JSON Logic expressions against supplied data. Provides a Jsonlogic class with an apply method. Fully null‑safe and passes the official compliance tests.
use_when: you need a lightweight rule engine for feature flags or business logic
you want to evaluate JSON‑based decision rules without a backend
avoid_when: need a UI‑focused solution or extensive rule authoring tools
strengths: null safety and thorough test coverage
weaknesses: limited to JsonLogic only, no code‑generation or UI helpers
